name: latex-note
description: Create, convert and review Chinese technical study notes as native XeLaTeX projects and compiled PDFs.

interface.shortDescription: Chinese technical notes with native LaTeX equations and PDF review.
interface.longDescription: Successor to Word Team. Produces editable XeLaTeX sources, relative figure assets, a compiled PDF and validation evidence. Defaults to Latin Modern Math, automatic equation numbering and rendered page review. Supports conversion of existing Word notes while preserving originals.
defaultPrompt: 使用 LaTeX Note 制作中文技术学习笔记，交付源码工程和 PDF。
将这份 Word 笔记转换为完整的 LaTeX 笔记工程。
